summary: End-to-end testing of Events Manager + Public RSVP + Contact/Volunteer feedback + Site URL auto-detect for Caring Sisters Club. Seeded a temp admin user+session and injected session_token cookie on the preview host. Backend pytest: 14/15 PASSED (1 flake due to shared public rate-limit from previous full-flow test). Frontend UI driven in a real browser verified every testid in the review: admin events CRUD (create/edit/delete), RSVP panel, Campaign auto-detect host preview + invalid site_url rejection + empty save, public /events empty state, no (demo) text on Contact/Volunteer, and no EIN anywhere on public pages (/, /donate, /about, /transparency, /contact). All seed data (temp admin+session, QA events, RSVPs, @example.com submissions) deleted; staff_notify_email restored to caringsistersclub@gmail.com. 2 real paid donations preserved.

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter is shared bucket ('submission') across POST /api/submissions AND POST /api/events/{id}/rsvp with 5/min per IP. Legitimate scenarios can trip it: e.g., a volunteer filling the form on their phone, then immediately RSVPing to the same event within the same minute. Consider using separate buckets or raising RSVP limit, OR document the 60s cooldown in the destructive toast copy.

Contact.jsx: form fields (name/email/subject/message inputs) have NO data-testid attributes, only the submit button does. Adding contact-name-input / contact-email-input / contact-subject-input / contact-message-input testids would help future UI test coverage.
Volunteer.jsx: Same - fields lack data-testid. Only submit + success heading have them. Review request implicitly relies on these for E2E but none exist.

backend/server.py:_detect_site_url runs on every /auth/me call and does an upsert even when the host is unchanged (first condition only short-circuits the SET; the find_one still runs). Minor DB overhead but harmless.

backend/server.py:_clean_site_url rejects any path (parsed.path or parsed.query). This is strict; URLs like https://foo.org/ (trailing slash) are correctly stripped by rstrip('/') earlier, but https://foo.org/app would error. Acceptable per PRD.

Public /api/events returns image_url (if set). Public response includes capacity + seats_taken + spots_left but still exposes staff-facing capacity integer. Consider dropping capacity on public endpoint since 'X of Y spots left' is the only consumer and spots_left suffices.

success_rate.backend: 93% (14/15, 1 rate-limit flake with full semantic coverage elsewhere)
